performers.asset: KayKit_Mystery_Series6/1 - July 2024 - Combat Mech · Textur alt

residentHome: sein Bezirk: die Stadt im Körper, auf Streife von Abteilung zu Abteilung
structure: Alice mechanics, tight: card = name + claim (+ image only where it carries), short causal connectors; cyborg cop on patrol as garnish; opening analogy (asking for the manager, getting a statement) paid off with The Brain (press secretary) and the outro (complaints arrive 500 ms late)
synopsis: A spoken-word number from a card deck that describes the human body as a city. It is performed by a small armored police cyborg on patrol through that city, for whoever happens to be there.
bestOfReason: 1, 2: the city runs itself, the citizen was never asked.
11, 17, 19: his own unit heals, burns, bites itself.
15, 18: the real threats are inside; the spider has the better record.
31, 20: emergency mode as normal; training from his teens.
21, 23, 24, 30: looking beats the book; the institution rejects the finding; the quack stays on the payroll.
6: no manager, only a press secretary (pays off the opening).

omitted.3: manual card overlaps the cop's rulebook joke

orderReason: Patrol order: district, departments, alarm (immune → inflammation → autoimmune), inside threats (DNA → cancer), training (thymus), cold cases, method (blind eye), memo (brain), score.

songLineChanges.songLine: The decision was already underway five hundred milliseconds before you made it.
The Lungs: seventy square meters folded into your chest.
Eighty percent of the phone calls go up to the brain.

cues.cue: police radio squelch on the backbeat

beats: Unit Nine, Metropolis Police. Step behind the tape; you're in my district now.
Ever asked for the manager and got a statement? Every night I send my report to the top floor. Nobody has ever answered.

beats.text: The City Inside: it has been running the civilization while you were busy thinking about other things. You are the other things.
The Citizen: you have never once told this city what to do. It has never once asked your permission.
beats.post: No permit. I let it slide.

beats.text: The Heart: the brain can modify the rate. The brain cannot generate it. The badger drums alone.
beats.post: I wrote him up. He kept drumming.

beats.text: The Lungs: the only autonomic function with a manual override.
beats.post: The one switch they let me touch.

beats.text: The Gut, zombie commuters boarding: eighty percent of the phone calls go up to the brain. The subway runs the city.
The Kidneys: the original doping agency.
The Night Shift: sleep is not rest. It is the janitorial shift washing the thoughts out of the carpet.
beats.post: I skip it. Somebody has to watch.

beats.text: The Immune System, armored rats with riot shields: a library of every murder attempt. It remembers things you have forgotten.
Inflammation: the response that heals the wound becomes the mechanism that burns the city.
Autoimmune, crazed dog biting itself: the gun works fine; it's just pointed the wrong way.
DNA Replication: one error per billion letters. You have had cancer many times; the spider usually eats it.
Cancer, giant crab with fortress built on shell: it is not a disease; it is a competitor.
The Cortisol Architect, hamster in tie drowning in alarm clocks: the comfort zone is a chemical state.
The Aging Thymus: your immune repertoire was built when you were a teenager. Hope you read good books.
Andreas Vesalius: he looked at the body instead of the book. Everyone else was wrong.
Ignaz Semmelweis: he saved the mothers. The doctors committed him.
beats.post: I'd have arrested him too. Disturbing the peace.

beats.text: The Semmelweis Problem: the evidence is available. The implication is uncomfortable. We reject the finding.
The Humoralist: wrong in the facts, right in the vibe. It was the first Kayfabe.
The Blind Eye: the brain fills it in with best guesses. Trust, but verify.

beats.pre: Then the top floor answers. A memo:
beats.text: The Brain: the decision was already underway five hundred milliseconds before you made it. You are the press secretary, not the president.

beats: So there is no manager. Just a statement. I filed my report anyway.

beats.text: The Scorekeeper, sea urchin writing with feather quill: the body keeps the score because the body is the score.

beats: Night shift in my district: the badger drums, the janitors wash the carpet, the spider eats the errors, and a cop with a minigun writes to a press secretary.
Complaints go upstairs, of course. They arrive five hundred milliseconds late.
